about: KMO by the Korean Mathematical Society: middle- and high-school first rounds (short-answer, answers published), second rounds (proofs, morning/afternoon) and the spring final (최종시험, 2 days) for the previous year's KMO; papers from the official archive kmo.or.kr/kmo/sub07.html (files hosted on kms.or.kr / kmo.or.kr).
